items.title: Super Micro stock jumps on upbeat outlook
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Josh Lipton on Asking for a Trend to break down Super Micro's (SMCI) latest results and upbeat outlook, as strong demand for AI infrastructure continues to drive the company’s growth.

items.title: Morgan Stanley sees more upside in these stocks as 'chipflation' worsens
SanDisk Traded Margin Upside For Years Of Contracted Revenue
items.summary: The cap on gross margin that came with SanDisk's new supply contracts is what bought years of committed demand, and that trade is the case for the stock.

items.title: Arista Networks Stock Is Waiting On Parts, Not Orders
items.summary: Arista keeps raising its revenue outlook as it locks up components, which makes its supply agreements the real driver of the upside case.

items.title: DELL is Overvalued at 21.92X P/E: Should You Still Buy the Stock?
items.summary: Dell Technologies' AI server surge, record backlog and server refresh demand fuel growth, even as shares trade at a premium valuation.

items.title: HPE Stock Falls 2.9% as AI Upgrade Rally Unravels
items.summary: The reversal shows that investors still question whether extraordinary server and networking growth can support HPE's elevated expectations.

items.title: Is Rigetti Stock a Buy or Hold After Its Q2 Earnings Report?
